# Max Andrews

Max Andrews is the current Deputy of [District 4](https://flow.je/elections/district-4) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Max Andrews has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/max-andrews#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 4 with 48.4% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/max-andrews/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aE99nWl6xOg)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Max-Andrews-Deputy-St-Helier-North-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=23)

Max Andrews has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 4](https://flow.je/elections/district-4). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/19/st-helier-deputy-to-seek-second-term/)\]

- Facebook : [@MaxAndrewsPolitician](https://www.facebook.com/MaxAndrewsPolitician)
